rationale: The agent claimed to have processed a return and modified a pending order but did not authenticate the user, did not present or request explicit confirmation before performing order-changing writes, and provided final statements about specific items (Bluetooth speaker returned; laptop updated to 13-inch i5, 1TB silver) without showing supporting tool results. The policy requires authentication and user confirmation prior to any changes. Additionally, the agent did not verify availability or present alternative 13-inch options before changing the order, as requested. These gaps violate the stated policy, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
